time_basis: Host receive time and PC display-request time; no hardware synchronization.
data_definition: Arduino-reported values; firmware may already average ADC conversions.
firmware_rate: Not modified by Python. Optional exported sketch targets 50 Hz; verify actual rate.
timestamp_note: Optional T_US saved raw; not used for host/display alignment.

timing_assessment.limitation: Candidate applies only to this fixed geometry, firmware and averaging rule; not a raw-ADC settling time, hardware-synchronized measurement or 3D calibration pass.
timing_assessment.next_action: Validate with actual complementary patterns and check additivity before imaging. If any group is invalid, inspect traces; increase --hold for slow/drifting responses or improve serial sampling before accepting a wait time.
